sources.name: OpenFootballBase-Data
sources.release: data-1.24.6 (release commit 99fcbb6, 2026-11-23; manifest generated 2026-11-23T13:49:13Z; archive SHA-256 16539db3…80f9)

sources.licence: Data: CC BY-SA 4.0 (derived from Wikipedia; README 'Sources, licences and limits'). Code: MIT (LICENSE file — software only, not the data). Wikidata-derived parts CC0. Club logos: not part of the data licence (often non-free).
sources.commercialReuse: Permitted under CC BY-SA 4.0: attribution to Wikipedia contributors and the dataset; LANOVA's derived dataset must be shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike). Display on a commercial site is allowed with attribution. The derived squad/registry/results files are published under CC BY-SA 4.0 and kept separate from CC0 and LANOVA's own code.

coverageVerified.laliga2026_27: 20 club-seasons, 20 with a squad (24–43 players), 543 player rows; 380 fixtures, 129 completed results of 130 due fixtures (one suspended; 57 single-source results).
coverageVerified.segunda2026_27: 22 club-seasons, 22 with a squad (24–31 players), 597 player rows; no 2026/27 Segunda match table.
coverageVerified.fields: player name, Wikidata QID (1,028 of 1,140 rows; 112 without), shirt number (1,118), position GK/DF/MF/FW (1,114), sporting nationality (1,001), stint (loan_in 48, arrived_mid 6, left_mid 1), source page, section and revision for every row.
coverageVerified.revisionDates: All 62 cited revisions dated via the MediaWiki API: 1 before the summer window closed (Real Sociedad B, 2026-09-01T07:05Z), the rest 2026-09-12 → 2026-11-12.
coverageVerified.players: 1,140 dated public squad listings; only 333 of 1,028 player rows with a QID have a Wikidata membership check in this snapshot.

sources.accuracy: LaLiga 2026/27 fixtures: 380/380 identical to openfootball (CC0), dates included; results matchdays 1–7: 69/69 identical; Málaga CF line after matchday 13 identical to LANOVA's independently verified line (13 played, 0-5-8, 9–24, 5 points). Squads: 5 players listed at two clubs (flagged). Official LaLiga confirms Levante UD–Elche CF 1–1 on 2026-11-23; Rayo Vallecano–Athletic Club remains suspended and excluded from completed results. Málaga positions for Haitam, Joaquín Muñoz, Juan Cruz and Julen Lobete are separately corroborated against the official club roster; source positions are retained.
sources.freshness: Release of 2026-11-23; squad sources dated 2026-09-01 → 2026-11-12; weekly refresh does not touch squads (repository note), so the revision date of each squad is shown.
sources.missing: One LaLiga fixture suspended as of 2026-11-24; all Segunda 2026/27 results; birth dates for some players; logos/photos (rights not cleared).
sources.conditions: Use under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution and share-alike on LANOVA's derived files; show the dated-listing status and evidence scope of every player; state that Wikidata checks cover only 333/1,028 QID players; preserve source values for corrections; squads are listings, not official registrations; results single-sourced except where cross-checked; never used to lift the current-season probability gate.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.release: Live entities read 2026-11-24 (wbgetentities; lastrevid stored per item). SPARQL endpoint rate-limited to 1 request/minute during an outage; entity API rate-limited (HTTP 429), so player checks are partial and reported.
sources.inspection: Club items (42), the 2026–27 La Liga item Q138806502 (P1923: 20 participating clubs) and the 2026–27 Segunda División item Q139897969 (no participants recorded) read directly; player items read for P54 (with P580/P582), P569, P413, P27.

coverageVerified.clubs: 42/42 clubs have a QID; LaLiga participants on Wikidata equal the 20 registry clubs exactly; Segunda participants not on Wikidata.
coverageVerified.players: QIDs for 1,028 player rows (unique items listed in 2026/27 squads); P54 membership checked for the players fetched before the rate limit (see coverage-2026-27.json → wikidata.checked).

sources.accuracy: A P54 membership without an end date is NOT treated as proof of current registration; an end date before the as-of date marks the player UNVERIFIED; a missing statement is reported, not inferred.
sources.freshness: Live; each item's revision id stored.
sources.missing: Membership statements are often missing or outdated for recent transfers; Segunda participants missing.
sources.conditions: Identities and dates of birth (CC0) kept in a separate CC0 file; used for checks, never as the only proof of a current registration.

sources.name: OpenLigaDB
sources.inspection: No LaLiga or Segunda league for season 2026. getmatchdata/<shortcut>/2026 returns no match for la1, la2, laliga, laliga1, laliga2, la, PD, lali, esp1, sd, segunda. sources.licence: ODbL 1.0 (licence page, German version authoritative): commercial use allowed with attribution; share-alike applies to a publicly distributed modified database, not to displayed content.
sources.conditions: Nothing incorporated; no ODbL data in LANOVA's datasets. Re-check if a community-maintained 2026/27 Spanish league appears.

blockers: Current-season probabilities stay blocked: 57 recovered results remain single-sourced and the Rayo Vallecano–Athletic Club fixture remains suspended (129/130 due fixtures completed). The current-season gate is closed in results-readiness-2026-27.json.
